nodes.name: LoadImage
nodes.confirmed_purpose: Valid local PNG RGB/RGBA/L/LA fixture decoding, alpha choice, exact typed pixel/mask hashes and raw input digest.
nodes.remaining_limits: No native widget/catalogue admission, missing/invalid paths, other formats, animation, EXIF or MPO qualification.

nodes.name: LoadImagesFromDir
nodes.confirmed_purpose: Valid selected managed prefix, lexical/islice selection, typed list data and actual downstream LoadImage calls.
nodes.remaining_limits: Native absolute paths project to logical names. Directory HW masks versus downstream BHW masks use a declared comparison-only axis. Missing/empty/subdirectory-only native states remain excluded.

nodes.name: SaveMetadata
nodes.confirmed_purpose: Bounded valid PNG output, all256 input byte levels per channel, exact saved pixels/text/mode/file bytes and UI metadata.
nodes.remaining_limits: UUID4 names are separately observed and projected, not string parity. Oversize/invalid PNG keyword and non-atomic host-failure side effects remain excluded.
